cands.name: Ray Jeffers
cands.bio: Brannon Ray Jeffers is a Democrat who has represented North Carolina House District 2 (Person County and part of Durham County) since January 2023. He served on the Person County Board of Commissioners from 2008 to 2020. He attended Person County Schools, Piedmont Community College and N.C. A&T.

endorsements.text: Listed as endorsed by Waves of Democracy (a voter guide group) for the 2026 election.
State Employees Association of North Carolina (SEANC) endorsed him in his 2014 House race, which he lost.

cands.gaps: We could not find the city or county where he was born, or whether he has lived anywhere outside North Carolina. We found no documented statements or actions on data centers, homestead property taxes, land ownership, growth and land protection, immigration and H-1B, police funding, guns, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. The list of bills he sponsored did not load on the page we read, so none are reported. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022, 2024 or 2026. We found no controversies, foreign ties, or details of his work history outside public office.

qual.background: Current member of the N.C. House since 2023, previously a Person County commissioner from 2008 to 2020; his House assignments include Appropriations and Local Government.
qual.why: He has held both local elected office (about 12 years) and a state legislative seat, which fits the high band for writing law and the state budget. Committee assignments were not counted toward the score. His non-political work history was not found.
